inspection_scope: all files present before Stage S0 changes

classification_legend.E: unrelated SYNAPSE-specific cognition or product code

components.purpose: Rust workspace and reproducible dependency resolution for the two extracted crates.
components.contamination_risk: Low; build metadata only. Workspace membership does not authorize recursive behavior.

components.purpose: In-memory neuron/synapse graph, sparse activation indices, propagation, inhibition, reinforcement, recall, thought-crystal/reflex promotion, and language-token concept schemas.
components.contamination_risk: High; useful sparse data structures are interleaved with linguistic labels, fixed inherited cognition, heuristic learning, and concept-promotion claims that do not satisfy the new protocol.

components.purpose: Sample SYNAPSE runtime construction and tests for Korean-language market cues, resonance, crystals, reflexes, feedback, and learned schemas.
components.contamination_risk: High; demo semantics and expected behaviors could be mistaken for autonomous concept emergence or leak task structure.

components.purpose: Tokenization and string similarity used by inherited activation routing.
components.contamination_risk: Medium; language matching is not concept semantics and may encode surface-form shortcuts.

components.purpose: Thin bounded candidate lookup and activation-index reporting wrapper.
components.contamination_risk: Low if used only for sparse routing and never counted as semantic evidence; current implementation inherits language-token indexing.

components.purpose: Hard-coded lexical routing among finance, emotion, and daily domains.
components.contamination_risk: High; benchmark/domain-specific language branches conflict with blind semantic evaluation.

components.purpose: String-to-string hot-path result cache.
components.contamination_risk: High; direct trigger/result storage is a solution-cache mechanism and cannot be treated as a concept.

components.purpose: Metadata stubs for inherited compression kinds, archive counts, and schema use counts.
components.contamination_risk: Medium; names imply semantic compression without executable, transfer, counterfactual, provenance, or ablation evidence.

components.purpose: Label/definition-oriented concept nodes, recall scores, context binding, definition graphs, and string-based definition application.
components.contamination_risk: Critical; definitions and labels are represented as concept semantics, directly conflicting with the Constitution.

components.purpose: Risk classification, approval scopes, autonomy levels, and action decisions for recursive development.
components.contamination_risk: High; it contains levels that permit proposal and approved sandbox mutation, although original writes and network/Git actions were already blocked.

components.purpose: Reads and indexes Rust source, classifies failures, selects files, creates patch plans/diff proposals, and records development memory.
components.contamination_risk: Critical; automated source inspection and proposal generation could adapt the experiment to benchmark outcomes. It reads files but contains no real write operation.

components.purpose: Creates guarded sandbox working copies, writes simulated patch markers, models allowlisted test execution, and checks original integrity.
components.contamination_risk: Critical; this is the only inherited recursive module with filesystem writes. Writes are path-guarded to sandbox areas and no process execution exists, but mutation is forbidden for SEM-0.

components.purpose: Parses test/benchmark feedback, revises patch plans, stores lineage and coding lessons, and gates feedback-driven changes.
components.contamination_risk: Critical; benchmark feedback could drive recursive proposal revision and contaminate blind evaluation.

components.purpose: Orchestrates up to three approved sandbox patch/test/feedback iterations and creates human-apply request bundles.
components.contamination_risk: Critical; recursive benchmark-driven sandbox iteration is incompatible with an uncontaminated concept-emergence proof.

components.purpose: Coordinates growth goals, planning, proposal, dry-run, sandbox application, tests, feedback, and revision; its policy fields default Git commit/push to false.
components.contamination_risk: Critical; it is a high-level recursive-improvement orchestrator even though commit/push are modeled as disabled booleans rather than implemented operations.

components.purpose: Top-level self-development runtime with observe, plan, propose, dry-run, feedback, report, and supervised-loop modes.
components.contamination_risk: Critical; default policies block original writes/network/shell/Git, but callable modes generated plans/proposals and reports before S0 quarantine.

components.purpose: SYNAPSE artificial-embryo needs, growth-goal, scaffold, emergent-function, and maturity simulation.
components.contamination_risk: Critical; product-specific hard-coded growth semantics could be mistaken for autonomous abstraction.

components.purpose: Language-specific Rust/Python/Mojo idioms, error patterns, scaffolds, suggestions, and coding maturity.
components.contamination_risk: High; supplied high-level programming guidance and lexical templates are outside SEM-0 and could leak solutions.

components.purpose: Active-field budgets, residency tiers, memory-scale audit, cold-storage policy, device profiles, and synthetic efficiency benchmark reports.
components.contamination_risk: Medium; some sparse/resource ideas may be useful later, but synthetic readiness scores and recursive stack wake logic are not semantic evidence.

components.purpose: Crate boundary for inherited recursive modules and re-export of synapse-core.
components.contamination_risk: Previously exported every recursive module. S0 minimally changed this boundary to expose only immutable quarantine status and synapse-core.

components.purpose: Crate dependency declarations.
components.contamination_risk: Low; only serde and the local core dependency are declared. No LLM, HTTP, network, subprocess, Git, or provider dependency is present.

components.purpose: Inherited SYNAPSE architecture narrative referring to product layers and versions absent from this extraction.
components.contamination_risk: High; stale product claims and layout can cause context drift. It is subordinate to the new canonical documents.

components.purpose: Inherited activation, propagation, reinforcement, forgetting, competition, resonance, and thought-crystal model.
components.contamination_risk: High; a fixed inherited cognition model and crystal promotion rules must not be treated as the new hypothesis or supplied higher-order semantics.

components.purpose: Large inherited SYNAPSE safety history, version-specific prohibitions, and repository snapshot rules.
components.contamination_risk: Medium; many conservative rules align with S0, but version-specific product text is non-canonical and cannot authorize behavior.

components.purpose: Inherited extraction description, license notice, and build-artifact exclusions.
components.contamination_risk: Low; README terminology is historical and subordinate to canonical documents. The ignore rules exclude target/log/tmp artifacts.

capability_findings.filesystem_write_location: patch_sandbox only; guarded sandbox-copy and simulated-apply paths
